runtime: Local workerd + local D1/DO/R2; Vite serves actual dashboard source
auth: Real Better Auth password sessions. Second and third identities seeded only in isolated local fixture DB; no auth mocked.
scope: No deployed Cloudflare/Slack/provider execution, no production data.
checks: Owner created room through actual dashboard UI; authenticated realtime connected.
Two independently signed-in identities see the same room with server-attributed online presence.
Bidirectional UI messages persisted and synchronized; member received server invalidation frames.
Shared note authored through UI reaches member; message and exact-version note explicitly selectable as handoff context.
Third authenticated account cannot list/read guessed room or establish its shared-room socket.
Full browser reload restores persisted shared messages and notes behind member authentication.
Removing the active member closes their live view, clears cached message/note/presence content, and denies subsequent HTTP reads.
